result.title: Polynomial Residual Networks are Generically Identifiable
result.summary: We prove identifiability results for constant-width residual networks with polynomial activations and bias terms. For activations of degree at least five with generic coefficients, the fiber over a generic parameter is a singleton. For activations of degree at least three with no linear term after a suitable translation of the input, the generic fiber is given by translating biases and then scaling weights and translated biases by real roots of unity. These results specialize to networks without bias terms. With the same proof technique, we further derive necessary conditions for critical points of the ResNet parametrization, that are central in singular learning theory.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文针对带 bias 的定宽多项式激活残差网络，证明其参数化在一般情形下可辨识：激活次数足够高时，一般参数的原像为单点；次数较低时，一般纤维由平移 bias 并按单位实根缩放权重得到，并由此给出 ResNet 参数化临界点的必要条件。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 无直接联系，但其关于权重与 bias 对称性下的「可辨识性」结论，可能为判断 latent 推理状态是否由输入唯一决定、以及循环式残差结构中的表示等价类提供一种概念性参照，可供核查。
